column1: # note: The table prints one tax column for every filing status; it is repeated for each.

# note: pdftotext -layout runs the five printed columns of each page together, with headings inside rows. The text was made one printed column at a time instead, so -pages counts columns, not PDF pages (PDF pages 1-3): for p in 1 2 3; for x,w in 0,128 128,122 250,115 365,120 485,127: pdftotext -layout -f $p -l $p -x $x -y 0 -W $w -H 792.
